title: Prove exact mixed-target costs for binary semilinear groups
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR #5202 leaves mixed normal/outside targets open in the order-21 register model. This package proves **exactly one paid call per nonidentity diagonal target**, for any target mixture, any finite restored dirty workspace and free binary scalar mixing. It also proves optimal-word rigidity: after scalar normalization, each paid projector is supported only on target roles of its own type; no normalized optimal factor touches a restored identity role.

The same self-contained proof covers every odd prime p in `F2[C_(2^p-1) semidirect C_p]` with Frobenius action. A quotient character added to the natural representation gives displacement rank p for every nonidentity label. Rank telescoping supplies the lower bound; coordinate calls attain the full formal endpoint. The p=3 all-normal theorem remains Nick Petalas's credited result, rather than a new audit claim.

**Status:** scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration. This is a unit-price formal algebra theorem, not a physical supplier, complete multiplication theorem or new kappa. Native realization, ownership, routing/restoration implementation, frames, precision, stock/compiler and full recursive/outer costs remain unknown. The selected frontier and frozen predecessors are unchanged.

## Task and overlap

- Scientific base: fresh canonical main `ec2780e8aeb1c88acaf5e9e470ef8c68e7fbbb6c`, priority revision 7. [Claim and canonical status #5230](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5230), [handoff #1166](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19146275).
- Card `bit-new-register-model`, scope **changed** to #5202's released mixed-target boundary. This closes call-sharing feasibility in the stated family before any native implementation effort. The exact original card and boundaries are in `TASK.json`.
- Nearest predecessor: #5202 at `99ed6d2fc13101cb5ec0d3b1cdc826b75bc27fc7`; its natural-C7 theorem and rank representation are retained with credit. #2011 at `b971a6c68d6f60c2693b2057ecf3489efb75efc4` supplies the order-21 model and finite orbit census. Neither predecessor's code/census is imported or rerun as this contribution.
- Final paginated overlap on 2026-10-23 at 13:44–13:46 UTC: 308 open PRs, 4,515 closed PRs, 4,480 Discussion records, and all 6,998 notes at the publication head. Direct live PR/Discussion reads, including #1166, #5202 and #5230, agree. No competing mixed-target semilinear result appeared. #5239 only mentions our claim as an excluded, unrelated same-account investigation; its fifteen-owner graph classification is untouched. #5199/#5203/#5205 concern different groups/alphabets/targets. Arbitrary historical diffs and unpublished work remain coverage limits.
- Canonical main was fetched again on 2026-10-23 at 13:44 UTC: `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`. Priorities, catalogue, selected record and entry guidance did not change. #5202 is now merged, with byte-identical cited proof. The scientific base and frozen evidence remain pinned; the isolated addition does not require a rebase.

## Validation

Publication head: `8fbd8d3a8fdea5c9fc4cf4c529ea43ccc7570917`. Local CPython 3.12.12 on macOS arm64, standard library only. Normal/optimized direct and registered checks, metadata, source-history/committed bytes and the Git-free export were rechecked on 2026-10-23 at 13:45 UTC; receipts are identical to the earlier verified export.

- Exact finite fields: every label at p=3,5,7; all representation products at p=3,5, and left/right generator products at p=7. Actual finite-field elimination checks 6,372 paid tensor factors. All 4,704 GL3/idempotent covariances pass.
- A separately implemented full-formal checker examines **328,000 ordered two-call words**, without rank-based pruning. All 1,600 two-target endpoints are attained, including 672 mixed ones, with zero optimal-support/type-count violations. It also checks a valid noncoordinate optimal word.
- A five-role regular-action replay checks all **105 basis inputs** with dense free maps mixing the dirty role; all 21 dirty-role basis states restore. A changed paid label causes 21 endpoint mismatches.
- Built-in controls cover omitted representation blocks, incorrect group law, higher-rank paid gates, omitted outside budget, composite degree, p=2, dropped formal terms, wrong support and wrong endpoints. Three additional temporary source mutations—omitted character, corrupted support predicate and omitted free inverse—fail in both normal and optimized modes.
- Registered normal/optimized replay, metadata/pins and exact committed-byte/source-history checks pass. Official export integrity and read-only **Git-free** normal/optimized replay pass with identical receipts and all seven file hashes unchanged. Export SHA256: `1e92d240a7d9072da65addf29825d4eaec690a9f818dad40ee91d22e29eca6fe`.

```sh
python3.12 -I -W error -B research/semilinear-mixed-tariff/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/semilinear-mixed-tariff/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/semilinear-mixed-tariff
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/semilinear-mixed-tariff --check-source-history
```

Direct runtime is about one second, with a 60-second bound per registered command. Universal quantifiers rest on `PROOF.md`, not finite extrapolation. Independent human/proof-kernel review, native/selected cold replay, Lean and Docker are unrun.

**Hosted CI passed** for exact head `8fbd8d3a8fdea5c9fc4cf4c529ea43ccc7570917` in [run 39964111143](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39964111143), completed 2026-10-23 at 13:53:04 UTC. `plan` passed in 4m07s; the sole selected package replay passed in 1m31s, including its registered normal/optimized commands. Run metadata confirms the matching head and successful conclusion. Passing CI is separate from independent scientific acceptance.

## Credit

Nick Petalas #5202; Cinna Davis / 1337isnot1337 #2011 and #3893; eumemic #288 and the retained register-model lineage. Prepared by **Krzysztof Wojt with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**, including bounded Luna overlap inventory and a separately implemented finite checker inspected, corrected and rerun by the primary agent. Apache-2.0. Exact source heads, the cited proof hash and baseline provenance are retained in the package.

## Open next questions

The README and TASK list two unreserved questions: nonuniform normal/outside prices, starting with two normal targets and the three-outside-call relaxation; and composite degree nine, where the current single-character rank equalization fails. Neither is needed for this theorem. Physical expansion requires an explicit native contract and complete bill.
